verses.text: Hallelu YAH! Blessed [is] the man fearing YHWH; in His commandments he has delighted greatly.

segments.text: Hallelu YAH! Blessed [is] the man fearing YHWH; in His commandments he has delighted greatly.

verses.text: His seed is mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

segments.text: His seed is mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.text: Wealth and riches [are] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

segments.text: Wealth and riches [are] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

verses.text: Light has risen in the darkness for the upright—[for] the gracious, and compassionate, and righteous.

segments.text: Light has risen in the darkness for the upright—[for] the gracious, and compassionate, and righteous.

verses.text: The good man is gracious and lends freely; he contains his affairs with justice.

segments.text: The good man is gracious and lends freely; he contains his affairs with justice.

verses.text: Surely he will not be shaken forever; the righteous will be as a memorial forever.

segments.text: Surely he will not be shaken forever; the righteous will be as a memorial forever.

verses.text: Of an evil report he is not afraid; his heart is firm, trusting in YHWH.

segments.text: Of an evil report he is not afraid; his heart is firm, trusting in YHWH.

verses.text: His heart is upheld; he will not be afraid, until that he looks on his enemies.

segments.text: His heart is upheld; he will not be afraid, until that he looks on his enemies.

verses.text: He has scattered—he has given to the needy; his righteousness stands forever; his horn is raised high in honor.

segments.text: He has scattered—he has given to the needy; his righteousness stands forever; his horn is raised high in honor.

verses.text: A wicked one will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked ones will perish.

segments.text: A wicked one will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked ones will perish.
